title: Every release now shows what it does with a picture or a diagram
text: Each release on the Releases page, and in the blue update bar's panel, now carries a screenshot when something on screen changed, or a diagram of the steps when it is a workspace or a process. New steps, locked steps and steps that move on by themselves are marked. Fourteen of the older workflow releases got a diagram too, for example Company Closure, Tax Return signing and fax, and the bank application review.
points: Open Releases from the left menu or the three-dots menu
In See what's new the diagram is a row of small boxes so it fits the panel
A change nobody can see is marked Behind the scenes and has no picture
